context_requirements: Intact ROCK1/ROCK2 expression and RhoA-ROCK signaling
Adherent, substrate-attached cells with active actomyosin contractility
Responsiveness is largely cytoprotective and anti-apoptotic rather than a strong transcriptional program
falsifiers: No reproducible directional change in any landmark gene at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Strong, uniform upregulation of proliferation and cell-cycle genes at 24 h across all lines
A response pattern indistinguishable from generic stress or DNA-damage signatures without any ROCK-pathway-linked genes

evidence.supports: ROCK inhibition promotes corneal endothelial cell adhesion, proliferation and survival
ROCK inhibitor offsets TGFbeta2-induced ECM and fibrotic gene expression changes
Y-27632 suppresses IL-1beta/TGF-beta receptor and caspase-8/-10 apoptotic pathway genes
Y-27632 protects human cardiac stem cells from doxorubicin-induced apoptosis
Y-27632 reduces dissociation-induced apoptosis and improves survival of primate ES cells
